user.title: Connect to the Rehom server
user.description: Enter the address of the Rehom server and the credentials you use in the Rehom app. This version only reads the plant: control from Home Assistant is disabled.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the Rehom server, for example rehomserver.local.
data_description.port: HTTP port of the Rehom server. The default is 8000.
data_description.username: User name of your account in the Rehom app (the end-user account, not the installer's).
data_description.password: Password of your account in the Rehom app.

discovery_confirm.title: Rehom server found
discovery_confirm.description: A Rehom server was found at {host}. Enter the credentials you use in the Rehom app to add it.

data_description.username: User name of your account in the Rehom app (the end-user account, not the installer's).
data_description.password: Password of your account in the Rehom app.

reauth_confirm.title: Authenticate again
reauth_confirm.description: The Rehom server at {host} refused the stored credentials. Enter the credentials you use in the Rehom app.

data_description.username: User name of your account in the Rehom app (the end-user account, not the installer's).
data_description.password: Password of your account in the Rehom app.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address of the Rehom server. It must be the same controller.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the Rehom server, for example rehomserver.local.
data_description.port: HTTP port of the Rehom server. The default is 8000.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Rehom server.
error.invalid_host: Invalid host name or IP address.
error.missing_mac: The Rehom server did not report its MAC address, so it cannot be identified.

abort.already_configured: This Rehom server is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: The configuration of this Rehom server is already in progress.
abort.wrong_device: This address answers with a different Rehom server than the one of this entry.

init.title: Rehom options
init.description: Control from Home Assistant is disabled in this version: every control action is refused.

data_description.temporary_comfort_duration: Hours of comfort used by the Set temporary comfort action when no duration is given (0.5 to 24).

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to the Rehom server at {host}.

control_disabled.message: Control from Home Assistant is disabled: this version of the Rehom integration is read-only.

invalid_auth.message: The Rehom server refused the username or password.

not_ready.message: The Rehom server has not been read yet.

unavailable.message: The Rehom server is not answering.

unsupported_api.message: The Rehom server answers in a format this integration does not understand.

wrong_device.message: The configured address answers with a different Rehom server.

zone_only.message: This action is only available for zone thermostats.

installer_session_active.title: An installer session is open on the Rehom controller
installer_session_active.description: The controller has reported an open installer (commissioning) session for more than 15 minutes. While it is open, the plant may not regulate normally. Home Assistant never closes it: end it from the installer tools or ask your installer.

season_mismatch.title: The Rehom season settings disagree
season_mismatch.description: For more than 15 minutes, the season the controller runs in has differed from the season in its installer configuration. Check the season with your installer. Home Assistant does not change the season.

setpoint_mismatch.title: The Rehom plant regulates to a different temperature
setpoint_mismatch.description: The house is in manual mode, but for more than 5 minutes the controller has regulated to {setpoint} °C instead of the selected level's {level_temperature} °C. The Rehom web app can leave this stale setpoint behind. To fix it, raise the selected level's temperature by 0.1 °C in the official Rehom app and lower it again: this rewrites the controller setpoint.

unsupported_api.title: Unsupported Rehom server version
unsupported_api.description: The Rehom server (web services version {version}) answers in a format this integration does not understand, for example after a firmware update. The integration keeps the last known state. Look for an update of the Rehom integration and report the problem.

unsupported_api_setup.title: Unsupported Rehom server version
unsupported_api_setup.description: The Rehom integration could not be set up: the Rehom server answers in a format this integration does not understand, for example after a firmware update. There is no automatic retry and no entity is available. Look for an update of the Rehom integration and report the problem; after updating, reload the integration.

clear_temporary_comfort.name: Clear temporary comfort
clear_temporary_comfort.description: Ends the temporary comfort of a zone. Control is disabled in this version of the integration, so this action is refused.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the weekly schedules of a zone for winter and summer: the preset bound to each weekday and its 48 half-hour levels, in controller time.

set_temporary_comfort.name: Set temporary comfort
set_temporary_comfort.description: Keeps a zone at comfort for a number of hours. Control is disabled in this version of the integration, so this action is refused.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Hours of comfort, 0.5 to 24 in steps of 0.5. Defaults to the duration set in the integration options.
